values.note: Recreation.gov rate table: standard electric site $30 a night in the 2026, 2027 and 2028 seasons (boat mooring sites $30, group shelter $35).

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233661 (facility description: 'The 29 RV sites and 8 boat sites are equipped with 50 amp electric and water hookups') + RIDB catalog (all 30 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 29 RV sites plus 8 boat (mooring) sites where campers sleep aboard. RV sites are back-in to 35 ft except one pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233661 ('The 29 RV sites and 8 boat sites') + RIDB catalog (STANDARD ELECTRIC: Max Vehicle Length 35, 30 Back-In / 1 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Trailer dump station: one RV dump per week of stay (two in 14 days); arriving campers dumping before occupying a site pay $20. Boat ramp and fishing pier.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233661 (amenities 'Showers', 'Dump Station'; description 'A boat ramp, fishing pier and trailer dump station are conveniently onsite'; dump-station notices), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bookable on recreation.gov up to the day of arrival (cutoff 0 days). 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days. Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.; the entrance gate opens at sunrise and closes at sunset.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233661 (facility_rules: maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0 days prior to arrival; notices on check-in/out and gate hours), read 2026-10-21

summary: Recreation.gov confirms $30 base (2026-28), 50-amp electric + water; added 29 RV sites to 35 ft (one pull-through), showers, dump station, 14-night max in 30 days. Not stated: campground season, sewer, booking window (inherited 180 left); a 'militaryDiscount' rule with no wording left alone.
